description: Official agricultural field boundaries (Nutzungsflächen) for Switzerland, covering 1,322,299 parcels across 17 open-data Cantons. Published in fiboa GeoParquet format, converted from data by the Conference of Cantonal Geoinformation and Cadastral Offices (KGK-CGC).

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Switzerland

Provides 1322299 official field boundaries from Switzerland.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Konferenz der kantonalen Geoinformations- und Katasterstellen.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Konferenz der kantonalen Geoinformations- und Katasterstellen](https://www.kgk-cgc.ch/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** Open-BY (https://opendata.swiss/de/terms-of-use)
- **Projection:** EPSG:2056

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://source.coop/fiboa/switzerland/switzerland.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/switzerland/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/switzerland/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/switzerland/switzerland.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property                    | **Data Type** | Description        |
|-----------------------------|---------------|--------------------|
| id                          | string        | Identifier         |
| area                        | float         | Area in ha         |
| administrative_area_level_1 | string        | Canton             |
| crop_name                   | string        | Crop name (German) |
| determination_datetime      | timestamp     |                    |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-13 from manually downloaded file .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.7.0
